# Place data

`cities.json` is built from GeoNames (https://www.geonames.org): `cities5000`
(every place with 5,000+ people), `admin1CodesASCII` and `countryInfo`,
licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
Only the name, region code, country, coordinates and population are kept.
